label: At GO, after reaching S1 when the trial before was an unrewarded S1 trial.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("state", -2) + tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 u")
terms: (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (tv("reward", -3) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 1) * (belief < 0.6) * (belief > 0.3)
explanation: Sparse feature (1.3% of steps), active only at GO. The largest magnitude comes when the last trial reached S1 and the trial before was an unrewarded S1 trial (S1 failing, so evidence against S1). Firing is strongest if the last trial was also unrewarded, and weaker but still present if it was rewarded. A last trial of a1 -> S1 unrewarded raises it a little on its own. In the short form, tv(state,-2)+tv(reward,-2)==1 encodes the trial before = S1 unrewarded, written that way to stay within three factors. The free fit adds the split of the last reward, an extra boost when trial -3 was also unrewarded, and a small boost for an uncertain belief (0.3-0.6), taking dev R^2 from 0.22 to 0.26. Belief log-odds magnitude, the choice and hidden variables add almost nothing. Most variance stays unexplained: activation goes on and off across consecutive windows in a sticky way that these additive history cues do not capture (the all-cue ceiling is only 0.29).
